ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to provide practical and hands-on training by simulating consulting projects. Students will develop proficiencies in problem-solving, team management, storytelling, and professional communications. As they learn the theories and practices of consulting engagements, students will have opportunities to discover how their knowledge in information sciences can be applied to various types of consulting services. The transferrable skills acquired in this class are applicable to other workplace settings. Always Restricted to Information Sciences majors. At this time, we do not plan on lifting the restrictions on the course. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
